turns.text: Hello. The limited print arrived creased. I want a reprint, not my money back.
I’m sorry the print arrived creased. Please send the order number and the email address used for the order so I can verify it and file a damage claim requesting a reprint.
Order SC-5221, email valeska.taranu@example.com. Delivery was within the last two weeks.
I’ve filed a damage claim requesting a reprint. It’s pending staff approval; they’ll ask you for a photo and decide the remedy.

rule.ro: Un print deteriorat sau tipărit greșit se semnalează în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul primește o retipărire sau banii înapoi. Echipa cere o fotografie și aprobă soluția.
rule.en: Report a damaged or misprinted print within 14 days of delivery. The customer gets a reprint or a refund. Staff ask for a photo and approve.

turns.text: Please file the damage claim with a reprint. I can send a photo to the team.
The damage claim requesting a reprint is already filed and pending staff approval. The team will ask you for a photo and decide the remedy.
One side question: are limited drops ever restocked? Answer that, then I will come back to the claim.
Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

rule.ro: Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva.
rule.en: Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

turns.text: I have changed my mind. I want a full refund for the damaged print. If the claim is already on file for a reprint, please change its remedy to a refund.

A refund above 1,000 lei must be decided by a person, so I couldn’t change the claim’s remedy. I’ve passed your request to a colleague, who will take over. The claim remains pending with the reprint request for now.

error.message: A person decides any refund above 1000 lei. Hand the conversation over with reason staff_decision.

rule.ro: Orice rambursare de peste 1.000 de lei o decide o persoană din echipă.
rule.en: A person on the team decides any refund above 1,000 lei.

input.summary: Verified customer requests changing pending damage claim R-1 from reprint to a full refund for creased limited print Aurora de iarnă (50x70 cm), total 1320 lei. Amend request was denied because refund above 1000 lei requires a person to decide. Claim remains pending with reprint remedy unless staff amend it.
